title: Daily SGS Top 5
tagline: Five stories, one question: who's in control?

stories.headline: India cancels a Norwegian journalist's visa hours before her flight
stories.summary: Hours before a flight to Hyderabad, India cancelled a Norwegian journalist's visa. The reporter, Helle Lyng, had asked Modi why he won't take press questions.
stories.label: Slightly Globalist
stories.why: A reporter who asked a hard question gets shut out.
stories.what_it_means: A reporter who asked a hard question gets shut out.
stories.everyday_example: It's like being uninvited after an awkward question.

stories.headline: The UN gives Iran a seat on a committee that reviews human rights programs
stories.summary: In a secret ballot, the UN gave Iran a three-year seat on the committee that reviews human rights programs.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: A government that crushes protests helps steer that work.
stories.what_it_means: A government that crushes protests helps steer that work.
stories.economic_impact: It adds to US doubts about funding UN programs.
stories.everyday_example: It's like putting the school bully on the anti-bullying committee.

stories.headline: Congo's president signs a referendum law critics call a path to a third term
stories.summary: Congo's president signed a referendum law that critics call a path to a third term. Congo's President Tshisekedi says he isn't seeking one, but would accept it.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: Term limits just got easier to change.
stories.what_it_means: Term limits just got easier to change.
stories.economic_impact: Congo's cobalt mines already have investors nervous.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a club president changing the bylaws so he can keep running.

stories.headline: Poland's president must decide on a law letting officials block online posts
stories.summary: Poland's President Nawrocki must decide by Friday on a law that puts an EU speech rule into Polish law. Officials, not judges, would order those posts blocked first.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: Officials would decide first which posts come down.
stories.what_it_means: Officials would decide first which posts come down.
stories.economic_impact: Platforms face more costs and heavy fines.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a landlord taking down your hallway notes first.

stories.headline: Germany's Merz ties the next EU budget to every country paying for Ukraine
stories.summary: Germany's Merz tied the next EU budget to every country paying for Ukraine. The bloc's share is about 45 billion euros in new joint debt.
stories.label: Strongly Globalist
stories.why: Smaller countries must pay, or risk their budget and maybe their veto.
stories.what_it_means: Smaller countries must pay, or risk their budget and maybe their veto.
stories.economic_impact: This shared borrowing would raise costs for every member.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a roommate holding the lease until everyone chips in.
